title: mapSpainHist: Historical Municipal Boundaries of Spain (1900-2001)
description: R package with the municipal boundaries of Spain for each population census between 1900 and 2001, provinces, judicial districts and historical electoral districts built from them, and the census figures of every municipality (1842-2011). The boundaries of historical municipalities are an approximate reconstruction: useful to represent municipal data graphically, to be used with caution for geographic variables such as area or distances. Code under MIT licence; the data (geometries and census tables) are under CC BY 4.0.
